observed.facings.png: Three facings at one shared scale. South: a stocky, hunched four-legged animal seen from the front. It has a vivid red head and neck, a pale grey hooked beak, blue-grey skin around each dark eye, a brown body with ridged folds, and heavy forelegs with big pale claws. East: a side profile. A humped, ridged brown body with a short tapering tail, thick forelegs with big curved claws, slimmer hind legs, and a long red neck held forward and roughly level with a vulture-like head, grey eye patch and pale hooked beak. North: the rear. It shows a ridged brown rump with a short tail stub, the hind legs and feet, and a narrow red neck column rising above the back with a small grey beak tip at the top. No eyes or face are visible. North looks a little narrower than south, but the heights match.
observed.south.png: Front view, face to camera. Red head with a pale beak pointing down, round dark eyes inside blue-grey patches. Brown ridged shoulders, four legs with large clawed feet. Clean alpha with no ground shadow.
observed.east.png: True side profile facing right. Painterly, realistic shading. Ridged leathery brown body, crimson neck, grey eye patch, pale grey hooked beak. The forelegs are visibly heavier than the hind legs, with large claws. No wings. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view. Ridged brown back and haunches, a short pointed tail, hind feet with claws. The red neck rises over the back, ending in a grey tip (the beak seen from behind). No eyes. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature is about a third of the human's height and roughly the length of half a cell. It reads as a small, low forager. At 32 px/cell it is a tiny brown shape with a red front end, legible as a small animal.

reply.image_seen: The shared-scale panel and individual south, east and north images show a brown, ridged quadruped with large clawed forelegs, a crimson neck and pale beak; south shows its face, east its extended neck, and north its back and haunches without eyes. The scale panel shows a small creature beside a human.

concerns.evidence: The torso has overlapping, tapered brown layers with scalloped edges across the shoulders and back, visible in south and east. These provide the required feathered-looking ridges while retaining tough skin; the deeper folds are concentrated around the limb joints. The requirement describes feathered-looking texture, which these layered ridges support.

North shows a narrowing crimson strip extending away beyond the brown shoulders, ending in the rear of the head with the pale beak tip pointing away. Its upward position on the image is consistent with the forward-reaching neck receding into depth under the elevated camera. There is no visible bend establishing an upright neck or disagreement with the east profile.

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South is a squat, broad-shouldered, hairless pale-grey beast seen head-on: a wrinkled face, small eyes, a heavy underbite with jagged fangs and a fringe of pale spines hanging from the lower jaw, and a spiky crest over the skull. The front legs are thick and splayed with clawed feet, and a thin tail hangs down between the legs behind the chest. East is a full side profile: a deep chest and heavy muscled shoulders taper to a lean, tucked waist and slimmer hind legs. Visible ribs, wrinkled bone-white skin with no fur, a row of bony scale plates from the brow down the neck to the shoulders, an orange eye, an underbite with protruding fangs and barbs fanning down from the lower jaw, and a long thin whip tail. North is the rear: the haunches, a thin tail hanging down the middle and ridged bony plates running down the back of the neck. No face or eyes; the ear tips just show past the shoulders. All three share the same palette and anatomy.
observed.south.png: Full-res south: front view of a pale, hairless, heavily wrinkled hound. Broad flat skull with a spiky bone crest, underbite with long uneven fangs and pale barbs hanging from the jaw, massive shoulders and forelegs, a thin tail visible between the legs. Clean alpha, no ground shadow.
observed.east.png: Full-res east: side profile, head to the right. Deep chest, heavy shoulders, slimmer hindquarters, thin whip tail curving behind. A crest of white bone-like scales runs from the skull to the shoulders. The jaw has an underbite with protruding fangs and barbs fanning downward. Skin is pale, wrinkled and hairless, ribs visible. Painterly, with a fine dark outline. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Full-res north: rear view. Haunches, hind legs, a thin tail hanging centrally and ridged bone plates over the neck and shoulders seen from behind. No eyes or face; only the ear tips poke out at the sides. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: Max zoom: a vanilla human head and torso beside the hound in profile. The hound stands about half a cell tall in a 1.75 drawSize footprint and is shorter than the human. At normal play (32 px/cell) it is a small pale shape on brown ground, smaller than the human, with a pale silhouette that separates clearly from the ground.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the face head-on: eyes, underbite, jaw barbs, chest and front legs toward the camera.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows haunches, the hanging tail and the back of the neck crest; no eyes or face, only ear tips at the silhouette edge.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are standing views at the game's angled camera; none is top-down.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Measured heights are 149 px on every facing (0% spread); in facings.png the south and north bodies read at the same height as east.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: Same pale, wrinkled, hairless body on every facing. The bone crest shows as a skull and neck ridge on south, a lengthwise row on east and back-of-neck plates on north, so it turns with the body. The tail is present in every view.

SIGNATURE.seen: A stout, vicious hunting canine: snarling underbite with fangs, heavy build, clearly a hound.

ALIEN.seen: The def names a canine body, so a dog-like read is allowed. The bone crest, jaw barbs and hairless wrinkled pale skin still make it read as an alien hound.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1. Stout, heavy-set canine build: present. Massive shoulders and deep chest on south and east.

CANON.seen: Body plan: deep chest, heavy shoulders, slimmer hindquarters, thin whip tail, all present (east). Colour: pale bone-grey wrinkled skin, no fur, present. Head: broad flat skull with a white bone-scale crest to the shoulders, present. Jaw: underbite, long uneven fangs, barbs fanning from the lower jaw, present on south and east. Negative: not furry and not a cartoon pup, satisfied.

STYLE.seen: Painterly, realistic anatomy, wrinkles and muscle rendered, fine dark outline; not cel, not cute.

OURS.seen: Bespoke art matching the card's canon. Not a vanilla or other-mod sprite.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on every facing; no shadow, ground or halo.

SCALE.seen: In scale.png the hound stands about half a cell tall, under the human's height. That is plausible for a large dog, though on the small side for a 'large' hound.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px/cell the pale silhouette stands out against brown ground as a quadruped with a spiky back, though it is small.
